scope: Safe bounded behavior for SVG geometry, paint, text/fonts, CSS, animation, links/resources, filters, masks, scripts, events, and output fidelity
status: advertised bounded subset directly evidenced; excluded surfaces fail closed

features.behavior: Self-contained vector geometry, direct presentation attributes, solid paint, local gradients, and local clip paths render through pinned resvg-wasm.
At most one explicitly bounded, singly applied filter chain may use Gaussian blur, offset, flood, composite, merge, or blend with at most eight total primitives and a 32-pixel blur deviation.
At most one self-contained, singly applied mask is accepted with userSpaceOnUse and an explicit region wholly inside the raster.
Text and text-path elements are rejected before renderer initialization because system fonts are disabled and the application ships no pinned, reproducible font set.
Style elements, inline style attributes, and imports are rejected because the lexical preflight cannot safely bound the complete CSS cascade and resource graph.
SMIL animation and set elements are rejected because the pinned static renderer exposes no bounded deterministic timeline, frame-count, or frame-duration interface.
Links, images, media, embedded objects, external references, and non-local paint URLs are rejected before renderer initialization; browser tests observe zero matching outbound requests.
Scripts and event-handler attributes are rejected before renderer initialization and never execute.
Use elements and href attributes are rejected because a lexical source-element count does not bound recursively expanded instance trees.
DTDs, custom entities, CDATA, processing instructions after the optional XML declaration, prefixed elements, and malformed roots fail before rasterization.
The rasterized pixels are retained in PNG, but editable vector structure, document metadata, and color profiles are not retained.

registryDisclosures: Only self-contained UTF-8 SVG with explicit paired width and height, or the standard 300×150 intrinsic default, is accepted within a 4 MiB source and 8-megapixel raster budget.

One self-contained mask and one bounded Gaussian blur, offset, flood, composite, merge, or blend filter chain may each be applied once within a 6-megapixel effect budget and eight total filter primitives; every effect region must be explicit and remain inside the raster.
Scripts, event handlers, external resources, and links are rejected before rasterization; URL references are limited to declared local paint, clip, filter, and mask fragments.

Text is rejected because system fonts are disabled and no pinned font set is shipped; CSS and use-element expansion are rejected because the current lexical preflight cannot safely bound their cascade, resource, or expanded-element costs.

Animation is rejected because the static renderer exposes no bounded deterministic timeline or frame interface; unsupported filter primitives, DTDs, custom entities, CDATA, and processing instructions are also rejected.
Vector structure, text editability, metadata, and color profiles are not retained in PNG output.

engine.reproducibility: npm run build:svg copies the integrity-pinned package Wasm and is covered by the all-engine non-Docker reproducibility gate.

snippets: SVG scripts, CSS, external-resource, links, animation, and text elements are not accepted.
SVG external references, inline CSS, and event handlers are not accepted.
SVG paint URLs must be local fragment references.
SVG filters and masks are limited to a 6-megapixel raster budget.
SVG Gaussian blur is limited to a 32-pixel deviation.
`${profileId} from ${sourceName} produces a bounded independently decodable image`
SVG policy rejects text, CSS, animation, links, scripts, events, and use expansion before rasterization

coverage: mask and seven-primitive filter-chain rasterization with independent SSIM validation
text, CSS, animation, link, script, event-handler, and use-element rejection before rasterization
